title: μ_V = θ H^n ⌞ M and local H^n-integrability of θ (Besicovitch differentiation and Radon–Nikodym)
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N, μ := μ_V, M ⊆ U with μ(ℝ^N ∖ M) = 0, and θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ(x) > 0 and HasDensity n μ x (ENNReal.ofReal θ(x)) for every x ∈ M. Suppose that for every L ∈ (0,1], M is covered by a countable family of closed L-graphs over n-planes ((P, Γ) ∈ C_L, Γ closed, |q_P(y − z)| ≤ L|p_P(y − z)| on Γ). Then (a) θ is H^n-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U, and (b) μ(B) = ∫_{B ∩ M} θ dH^n (as the lintegral of ENNReal.ofReal ∘ θ) for every μ-null-measurable B ⊆ ℝ^N.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), M ⊆ U → V.weight Mᶜ = 0 → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x ∧ HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))) → (∀ L : ℝ, 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → ∃ C : Set (Grassmannian N n × Set (Euclidean N)), C.Countable ∧ (∀ c ∈ C, IsClosed c.2 ∧ ∀ y ∈ c.2, ∀ z ∈ c.2, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project c.1 (y - z)‖) ∧ M ⊆ ⋃ c ∈ C, c.2) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), NullMeasurableSet B V.weight → V.weight B = ∫⁻ x in B ∩ M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]
